positive_snippets: Big spacious rooms. Big spacious newly refurbished toilets.. The building is old and has no elevator, but it is just 3 flights of stairs so hardly matters. They supply RO water, they have a kitchen which serves decent food At a reasonable price. Check all your apps for a better price on the rooms.. For the price I paid, this room was a steal.
negative_snippets: The hotel is nothing like what you see in the pictures. The rooms are like of cheap hotel and really small. The picture they are using are either different property or gotten from internet. If you book room from make my trip, they would option delux and executive, with executive costing more money but there is no difference. Both are same. If you are foreigner, or international couple i would recommend to not stay here or around this area. Not very safe. If you can shell out some money i would recommend to check better hotel nearby like le season etc.

I am having a mixed experience.
The room which was shown on website was different from they gave. I asked the same to receptionist, the answer was "Do you find any problem in room?".

The basic things were fulfilled. But be cautious you might not get what you see.

Serving of the food was not that good. Serving tray was very very dirty. After asking another tray which was little better served, but from next time onward similar thing started coming.

Preparation time of food was little longer, but tastes good.

Except that rest of the things were alright. I got my suit ironed on time.

Construction work on other floor was in progress.

Very bad experience.”

From Delhi airport terminal 1, we reached the hotel at about 1.00 am. Before starting my trip, I had called the property two-three times to confirm a pleasant stay. When we reached here we found that some renovation work was going on and no rooms were available for stay. After repeated requests, they arranged a room in a hotel about half a km away. We had a bad experience that we had to walk this distance with all our luggages. The room provided was not at all good. Agoda, please make sure that the property exists in good condition before confirming our reservation.
